units.source_text: ……我和姑娘已经爬到坡道的尽头，来到了幽静的小原野。

en.t: The girl and I had already climbed to the end of the slope and come out onto a quiet little meadow.

units.source_text: 透过松树和杉树可以隐约望见大文字山、如意岳等远方的山。

en.t: Through the pines and cedars, we could faintly see distant mountains such as Daimonji and Nyoigatake.

units.source_text: 竹林子覆盖着从这片丘陵一直延伸到市镇的斜坡地。

en.t: Bamboo groves covered the sloping ground that stretched from this hill all the way down to the town.

units.source_text: 竹林尽头屹立着一株迟开花的樱树，花儿尚未凋谢。

en.t: At the edge of the bamboo grove stood a late-blooming cherry tree, its blossoms not yet fallen.

units.source_text: 那确实是迟开的花儿，大概是结结巴巴地开，也就迟迟尚未凋谢吧。

en.t: They were truly late-blooming flowers; perhaps because they had opened haltingly, they still had not fallen even now.
